name: Photo Synth
description: Play three photos: colour becomes tone — mono/unison (1-12 stacked voices) or true 4-note polyphony with 1-4 oscillators per note — plus filter, envelope and an FX matrix square that blends four effect parameters from its corners. On-device presets with photo snapshots and file export. Motion automation, live camera mode, MIDI import (with real chords), keyboard, and 24-bit WAV export.
note: On iPhone, sound follows the ring/silent switch.
